situations.title: 예상 출혈량 파악
situations.tagline: Let's talk expected blood loss for this case so we're all prepared.
situations.brief: 수술의 예상 출혈량을 팀과 공유하세요.
keyPhrases: What's the expected blood loss for this procedure?
I'll have extra suction and lap pads ready.
I'll track EBL as we go.

situations.title: 흡인 출혈량 측정
situations.tagline: How much is in the suction canister so far?
situations.brief: 흡인기의 출혈량을 측정해 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: The canister shows about 300 milliliters so far.
I'll subtract the irrigation from that number.
I'm keeping a running total of the EBL.

situations.title: 거즈 무게 출혈 추정
situations.tagline: Can you weigh those sponges so we can estimate the blood loss?
situations.brief: 사용한 거즈의 무게를 재어 출혈량을 추정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll weigh the sponges to estimate the loss.
Dry weight subtracted, that's about 150 milliliters.
I'll add this to our running EBL.

situations.title: 지혈 기구 준비
situations.tagline: Can you have the cautery and hemostatic agents ready to go?
situations.brief: 지혈에 필요한 기구와 물품을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Cautery is on and set, ready when you need it.
I have hemostatic agents open on the field.
Extra clips and ties are within reach.

situations.title: 출혈 부위 보고
situations.tagline: There's some steady bleeding from the lower edge — do you see it?
situations.brief: 출혈 부위를 팀에 명확히 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm seeing bleeding at the lower margin.
More suction here so you can visualize it.
Do you want a clamp or cautery for that?

situations.title: 수액로 개통 확인
situations.tagline: Both IV lines are patent and running well on my end.
situations.brief: 정맥로 개통 상태를 확인하고 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Both IVs are patent and flowing freely.
I've got fluids running wide open if we need it.
Let me know if you want another line placed.

situations.title: 출혈량 증가 추세 보고
situations.tagline: The bleeding's picking up — our EBL just jumped over the last few minutes.
situations.brief: 출혈량 증가 추세를 감지해 팀에 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: The EBL is trending up faster than expected.
We've lost about 500 milliliters in ten minutes.
Do you want me to alert anesthesia and get blood ready?

situations.title: 국소 지혈제 적용
situations.tagline: Do you want the topical hemostatic agent on that bleeding surface?
situations.brief: 국소 지혈제를 준비해 출혈면에 적용을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: I have the hemostatic matrix ready to apply.
Let me pack it against the bleeding surface.
Hold pressure while it sets up.

situations.title: 응고검사 결과 반영
situations.tagline: The coags just came back — the INR is elevated and platelets are low.
situations.brief: 응고검사 결과를 확인해 팀 처치에 반영하세요.
keyPhrases: The latest coags show a coagulopathy developing.
Do you want FFP and platelets ordered now?
I'll call the blood bank to get products ready.

situations.title: 저혈량 초기 징후
situations.tagline: His pressure is drifting down and the heart rate's climbing — I think he's getting hypovolemic.
situations.brief: 저혈량의 초기 징후를 인지해 팀에 알리세요.
keyPhrases: His pressure is trending down and heart rate is up.
These look like early signs of hypovolemia.
I'm opening up the fluids and calling for blood.

situations.title: 대구경 라인 추가
situations.tagline: We need another large-bore line in — can you help me get access?
situations.brief: 추가 대구경 정맥로 확보를 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll grab a large-bore catheter for you.
Second line is in and running wide open.
Do you want a rapid infuser hooked up?

situations.title: 가온 수액 준비
situations.tagline: Let's get the fluid warmer going before we push more volume.
situations.brief: 저체온 예방을 위해 가온 수액을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm setting up the fluid warmer now.
All the volume will run through the warmer.
We'll keep his temperature from dropping.

situations.title: 세포회수기 사용
situations.tagline: Should we start the cell saver to recover and give back his own blood?
situations.brief: 세포회수기(cell saver)를 준비해 운용을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll get the cell saver set up and primed.
We can salvage and return his own red cells.
The reservoir is collecting now.

situations.title: 출혈 원인 팀 논의
situations.tagline: Is this surgical bleeding or is his coagulation the problem — what are we seeing?
situations.brief: 출혈 원인을 팀과 함께 논의하세요.
keyPhrases: Is this a surgical bleeder or a coagulopathy?
The coags will tell us which way to treat.
Let's address both while we investigate.

situations.title: 소변·관류 감시
situations.tagline: Urine output's dropping — how's his perfusion looking on your monitors?
situations.brief: 소변량과 관류 지표를 감시해 팀에 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Urine output is down to under 30 an hour.
That suggests his perfusion is compromised.
I'm watching lactate and capillary refill too.

situations.title: 급성 대량 출혈
situations.tagline: We've got sudden massive bleeding — I need more suction and blood in the room now.
situations.brief: 급성 대량 출혈에 흡인과 수혈 자원을 신속히 동원하세요.
keyPhrases: This is massive hemorrhage — I'm calling for blood now.
Second suction coming, and I've got more lap pads.
I'll keep tracking EBL and update you.
goals: 급성 대량 출혈에 흡인과 수혈을 즉시 동원한다

situations.title: 혈압 급강하 순환 허탈
situations.tagline: His pressure just crashed — we're heading into circulatory collapse.
situations.brief: 혈압 급강하와 순환 허탈에 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Pressure has crashed — pushing pressors now.
Volume wide open through both lines and the warmer.
Tell me the moment you have control of the bleeding.

situations.title: 응고병증 발생
situations.tagline: He's oozing everywhere now — this is turning into a coagulopathy.
situations.brief: 응고병증 발생에 혈액제제로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: He's coagulopathic — I need FFP and platelets now.
Calling blood bank for cryo as well.
Let's correct the coags while you get hemostasis.

situations.title: 대량수혈 프로토콜 발동
situations.tagline: I'm activating the massive transfusion protocol — get the cooler up here fast.
situations.brief: 대량수혈 프로토콜(MTP)을 발동해 혈액 공급을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm activating the massive transfusion protocol.
First cooler is on the way with the ratio ready.
I'll track units in and keep the counts straight.

situations.title: 지혈 불가 손상통제
situations.tagline: We can't get control here — let's pack it and go to damage control.
situations.brief: 지혈이 불가능할 때 손상통제 전략으로 전환하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's pack and shift to damage control.
I have packing and a temporary closure ready.
Plan to get him to ICU to resuscitate and return.
goals: 지혈 불가 상황에서 손상통제 전략으로 전환한다

situations.title: 심정지 임박 출혈
situations.tagline: He's about to arrest from blood loss — get the crash cart and start compressions if we lose the pulse.
situations.brief: 출혈로 인한 심정지 임박에 소생 준비를 하세요.
keyPhrases: He's about to arrest — crash cart at the bedside.
If we lose the pulse, I'm starting compressions.
Keep the blood going wide open through the warmer.
goals: 맥박 소실 시 즉시 소생을 개시한다
